title: May an agent manufacture its next assignment when current work is blocked?
question: May an agent manufacture its next assignment when current work is blocked?
answer: WB-15: It does not create a next task for itself. An agent picks up its assigned task and works it autonomously; if information is missing it investigates and resolves it within that task from project evidence. Only when it cannot is a separate new task needed for a new agent, and the current agent does not manufacture that queue item or treat its absence as routine blockage.
